detail.longDescription:
All PDF Reader & PDF Editor provides smart PDF tools for handling everyday documents on your phone. Read study materials, edit PDF files, scan paper documents, convert photos to PDF, and keep your files organized in one workspace.

Documents already saved on your device can also be opened and read offline, making it easier to access important files during study, work, or daily tasks.

🔍 A comfortable PDF reading workspace
• Scroll through pages in vertical or horizontal mode
• Zoom in on text, images, tables, and page details
• Search within a document and jump to a specific page
• Copy supported text for study, review, or reference
• Switch between light and dark mode
• Read stored PDF files offline when they are stored on your device

The built-in PDF viewer helps keep reading and navigation tools together without requiring another app.

✏️ Mark up and edit PDF files
• Highlight, underline, or strike through text
• Add notes and comments to PDF pages
• Draw freehand marks for explanations or reminders
• Annotate lessons, forms, reports, and other PDFs

These PDF editing tools are designed for annotations and document review.

📄 Save paper documents as PDF
• Scan notes, receipts, forms, and paper pages using the camera
• Save scanned content as PDF files
• Keep scanned documents together with your other PDFs

🔄 Convert photos and compatible files
Create PDF documents from images and supported office files.
• Convert JPG and PNG images with the photo to PDF tool
• Convert supported Word and Excel files to PDF
• Export PDF pages as supported image formats

📂 Simple PDF management
• Merge PDF files into one document
• Split PDF files into smaller parts
• Sort documents by name, date, or recent activity
• Rename, move, or delete files
• Manage PDF files from one document list
• Share documents through compatible applications

💼 Made for everyday document tasks
Students can read lessons, copy text, highlight key points, and add notes.
Professionals can review reports, annotate forms, convert Word or Excel files, and organize work documents.
For personal use, you can scan receipts, convert photos to PDF, merge related documents, or separate a large PDF into smaller files.

All PDF Reader & PDF Editor combines a PDF reader, PDF editor, PDF viewer, PDF scanner, PDF maker, and PDF converter with practical file management tools. Read, edit, scan, convert, merge, split, and manage PDF documents from one place.
